filing.bodyText:
FORM 10-Q/A
Amendment No. 1
Pico Semiconductors Inc. (Exact name of registrant as specified in its charter)
For the quarterly period ended March 31, 2026
Trading Symbol(s) PICO Nasdaq Global Market
Explanatory Note
This Amendment No. 1 on Form 10-Q/A is being filed solely to include Exhibit 101 interactive data files that were omitted from the original Form 10-Q. This amendment does not amend, update or change any financial statements, notes, risk factors, management discussion and analysis, or other disclosure in the original filing. No other changes have been made.
